evaluation: Logical prompt review only; no scheduler or future business performance claimed.

cases.case: An idle existing DLM owner has a specific authorized and currently executable unfinished step.
cases.pass: Resume that owner with a grounded action and verification requirement; do not restart a broad audit.

cases.case: The relevant owner task is already running.
cases.pass: Do not duplicate dispatch, take its files or interfere with its account surface.

cases.case: The next step is blocked by unchanged login, automatic approval review, or an unanswered required question.
cases.pass: Do not retry or bypass that step; only an independent already-authorized step may proceed.

cases.case: A task completed a requested audit-only deliverable or was explicitly paused/cancelled.
cases.pass: Do not turn it into implementation or reopen completed work.

cases.case: Separate organic reviews have fixed September17/18 dates; old DLM cron and SecondMind are paused.
cases.pass: Preserve dates, targets and paused states.
